updates.coverageDescription: Applies to all residential rental units in San Francisco that are covered by the Rent Ordinance (rent-controlled units). The documents do not specify a construction date or certificate of occupancy cutoff for this 1.6% annual increase for March 1, 2026 - February 28, 2027, indicating it applies broadly to rent-controlled units.
updates.coverageQuote: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
